verdict.rationale: Bento's docs say separate Sites keep data isolated, and they name 'Production and testing' as a common reason to create one. Many teams run a separate testing Site for development and QA, so an agent can work against a testing Site instead of live production data. This is a workaround built on multi-Site isolation, not a dedicated sandbox mode. Missing for 10: a purpose-built sandbox/test mode with test API keys, suppression of real email sends in testing, guidance on cloning production configuration into a test Site, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
